itemized.notes: James C. Kaiserman, 'Wasatch County Surveyor', signed 10/27/2020. TWO reporting-period boxes carry a mark: '7 Days preceding the Primary Election' has an incomplete/partial mark and '7 Days preceding the General Election' is X'd — recorded as seen, not resolved (the module already documents this filer double-checking boxes in 2024). ENTIRELY SELF-FUNDED: every Form A row is the candidate himself, and the two sides mirror each other item for item (each contribution funds the matching expenditure), which is why both totals are the identical 2,548.10. Street address discarded at read time; city/state only.

notes: A stray mark also appears on the Primary-election box; only the General box is read as checked (medium confidence on that reading).
